bio: If you’re looking for a romantic getaway venue in the picture postcard perfect city of Bruges, book a table in the restaurant of the Relais & Chateaux Heritage Hotel, whose opulent interior oozes authentic historic details. It is truly the epitome of stylish elegance! The chef avows a preference for French and Mediterranean ingredients, which he delicately crafts into spot-on dishes. Examples include a marinated fillet of mullet paired with sweet-sour fennel, labneh and radish pickles. Each dish is a master class of subtlety and originality. A date night kinda place with which you will immediately fall head over heels....
